title: Culture: Mythical places around the world

sentences.en: There are very few places on Earth that are undiscovered and we have satellite photos of the most remote places on the planet.
sentences.zh: 地球上几乎没有还没被发现的地方了，我们连这颗星球上最偏远的地方都有卫星照片。

sentences.en: But people are always interested in mythical lands, places that people say exist but no one has ever found.
sentences.zh: 但人们一直对神话中的土地感兴趣，也就是人们说它存在、却从来没有人找到过的地方。

sentences.en: Perhaps the most famous mythical place of all is Atlantis.
sentences.zh: 也许所有神话之地里最有名的就是亚特兰蒂斯。

sentences.en: Some people say it is a city, others say it is an island and others call it a continent.
sentences.zh: 有人说它是一座城市，有人说它是一座岛，还有人说它是一块大陆。

sentences.en: But whatever it is exactly, there is one thing that everyone agrees on: it is underneath the sea.
sentences.zh: 不过不管它到底是什么，有一件事大家都同意：它在海底。

sentences.en: The Greek philosopher Plato was the first person to describe it and he suggested that one time, its people attacked Athens.
sentences.zh: 希腊哲学家柏拉图是第一个描述它的人，他说有一次，它的居民攻击了雅典。

sentences.en: No one is sure exactly where Atlantis is.
sentences.zh: 没有人确定亚特兰蒂斯到底在哪里。

sentences.en: Because of its name, some people think it is somewhere in the Atlantic Ocean.
sentences.zh: 因为它的名字，有些人认为它在大西洋里的某个地方。

sentences.en: Others say it’s in the Mediterranean Sea or in the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 也有人说它在地中海或加勒比海。

sentences.en: Agartha is another mythical place that is not on the land.
sentences.zh: 阿加尔塔是另一个不在陆地上的神话之地。

sentences.en: The legend says that it’s at the centre of our planet.
sentences.zh: 传说它在地球的中心。

sentences.en: Like Atlantis, it is famous for its culture and educated society.
sentences.zh: 和亚特兰蒂斯一样，它以文化和有教养的社会著称。

sentences.en: It was the inspiration for Jules Verne’s novel Journey to the Centre of the Earth.
sentences.zh: 它是儒勒·凡尔纳的小说《地心游记》的灵感来源。

sentences.en: It tells the story of a group of travellers who go on an exciting adventure underground.
sentences.zh: 那本书讲的是一群旅行者在地下进行刺激冒险的故事。

sentences.en: Many people have tried to find the entrance to Agartha, which they think is somewhere in Antarctica.
sentences.zh: 很多人试图找到阿加尔塔的入口，他们认为入口在南极洲的某个地方。

sentences.en: Some people believe that somewhere in South America there is a famous city of gold: El Dorado.
sentences.zh: 有些人相信在南美洲的某个地方有一座著名的黄金之城：埃尔多拉多。

sentences.en: Many people tried to find it, but they weren’t successful.
sentences.zh: 很多人试图找到它，但没有成功。

sentences.en: El Dorado was originally the name of a person, a ruler of the ancient Colombian society called the Muisca.
sentences.zh: 埃尔多拉多最初是一个人的名字，他是古代哥伦比亚社会穆伊斯卡人的统治者。

sentences.en: He covered himself in gold powder every day.
sentences.zh: 他每天都会把金粉涂在身上。

sentences.en: There were legends in which people imagined that the whole city was made of gold.
sentences.zh: 在一些传说里，人们想象整座城市都是黄金做的。

sentences.en: Our final mythical land is an island called Thule.
sentences.zh: 我们要说的最后一个神话之地是一个叫图勒的岛。

sentences.en: The legend says that it is in the north of the Earth, somewhere between Norway and Iceland.
sentences.zh: 传说它在地球北部，位于挪威和冰岛之间的某个地方。

sentences.en: This is an area of the world that is completely dark for a lot of the year.
sentences.zh: 这是世界上一年中很多时间都完全黑暗的地区。

sentences.en: But the story goes that Thule is a place where a lot of delicious food grows and people are always happy.
sentences.zh: 但故事里说，图勒是一个能长出很多美味食物、人们总是很快乐的地方。

sentences.en: The Roman poet Silius Italicus wrote about Thule.
sentences.zh: 罗马诗人西利乌斯·伊塔利库斯写过图勒。

sentences.en: In his story, the people living there are painted blue.
sentences.zh: 在他的故事里，住在那里的人都被涂成蓝色。
